document_host.note: Idox PublicAccess_Live DMS. There is no documents tab on the Idox side: applicationDetails.do?activeTab=documents returns a 200 page reading 'Permission Denied' (not a 403), even after visiting the summary tab on the same session, which reads as bot-blocking but is not. The summary page's tab list shows 'externalDocuments' instead, carrying the single off-host link to this store. The DMS needs no cookie from the Idox session.

endpoints.note: Reach the DMS from the Idox side with applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal>, which carries the single off-host link. FOLDER1_REF is the human reference with slashes, not the keyVal. The RunThirdPartySearch page embeds the document list as inline JSON rows ({"Guid":…,"Doc_Type":…,"Date_Received":…,"Doc_Ref2":…}); each Guid is then a ViewDocument download.

quirks.summary: No documents tab — documents live on a separate PublicAccess_Live DMS, and the standard Recipe C documents tab answers HTTP 200 with 'Permission Denied'.
quirks.detail: A run that follows Recipe C as written gets a 200, finds no file links and reports no error, so the application looks like it has no documents. The 'Permission Denied' text reads as bot-blocking but is not: it persists on a warm session that has just loaded the summary tab.
quirks.workaround: GET applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal>, follow the single off-host link to the DMS, and use the endpoints recorded above.

quirks.summary: DMS downloads carry no Content-Disposition header — derive the file extension from the content-type.
quirks.detail: Not everything is a PDF: biodiversity net gain workbooks arrive as application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroenabled.12 and belong in a .xlsm.

quirks.summary: A stale _csrf token does not error — the advanced search returns a normal page reading 'No results found'.
quirks.detail: The very first cold request may carry no token at all, so an unwarmed session fails the same silent way.
quirks.workaround: Warm the session first, fetch a fresh token from search.do?action=advanced before EVERY search, and treat 'No results found' as unverified until a date-only control search on the same session returns results.

quirks.summary: Documents tab returned no file links for a real application.
quirks.detail: Either this application genuinely has no published documents, or the documents live somewhere the standard link pattern does not match. One application was sampled, so this is a signal, not a verdict.
quirks.workaround: Sample a second application before concluding; check for an externalDocuments tab.

pacing.note: Single-threaded at >=2s spacing sustained a 53-application / 10,040-document pull in August 2026 with zero failures.

robots.note: robots.txt disallows the search path for our UA

development_type_classification.evidence: A 230-dwelling outline sat in 'Largescale Major Other' (006), not in Dwellings.
development_type_classification.method: Union the developmentType searches with description-keyword sweeps and hand-triage the result.

source_notes:
DMS host iawpa-equivalent is padocs.midsussex.gov.uk, FileSystemId=DM. EXTERNAL-DMS VARIANT of Recipe C — the one that breaks the standard recipe. There is NO documents tab: applicationDetails.do?activeTab=documents returns a 200 page reading 'Permission Denied' (not a 403), even after visiting the summary tab on the same session, which reads as bot-blocking but is not. The summary page's tab list shows 'externalDocuments' instead. GET applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal> and take the single off-host link to a PublicAccess_Live DMS: <dms-host>/PublicAccess_Live/SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=<id>&FOLDER1_REF=<application reference>. That page embeds the document list as inline JSON rows ({"Guid":…,"Doc_Type":…,"Date_Received":…,"Doc_Ref2":…}); each file is then <dms-host>/PublicAccess_LIVE/Document/ViewDocument?id=<Guid>. No Content-Disposition header — take the extension from the content-type (BNG workbooks arrive as application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroenabled.12 -> .xlsm). The DMS needs no cookie from the Idox session; FOLDER1_REF is the human reference with slashes, not the keyVal. SILENT CSRF FAILURE: a stale _csrf token does not error — the advanced search returns a normal page reading 'No results found'. Fetch a fresh token from search.do?action=advanced before EVERY search, and treat 'No results found' as unverified until a date-only control search on the same session returns results. The very first cold request may carry no token at all — warm the session first.

Proven at scale: 53 applications / 10,040 documents downloaded Aug 2026, zero failures, single-threaded at >=2s spacing. Tooling: research/midsussex-majors/tools/ (enumerate.py, filter_majors.py, download_docs.py — resumable). developmentType classification is NOT sufficient for cohort work here: a 230-dwelling outline sat in 'Largescale Major Other' (006), not Dwellings — union the devtype searches with description-keyword sweeps and hand-triage.
